description: Road Hierarchy is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. A description of the hierarchy role performed by different parts of the road network. It also provides criteria to describe each road role type. The role type designated to each road should represent the role that the road is intended to perform. It may not necessarily reflect the current conditions on the road. Coverage: Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are Road Assets, open data. It offers 8 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-07-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
